title: Remove prototype emotion_myths field and derive suppression/secondary emotions from existing traits, memories, and witnesses
goal: Keep VirtualWorld's emotion design grounded strictly in existing persona traits, memories, and room audience with zero duplicate psychology properties.

sections.what: Remove the prototype-only emotion_myths / EMOTION_MYTHS construct added in prototypes/emotions/ and docs/design/emotion-system-redesign.md, replacing it with suppression, calming-resistance, and secondary-emotion derivation from existing VirtualWorld persona traits, recalled memories, and witnesses.
sections.why: emotion_myths does not exist anywhere in VirtualWorld outside the prototype and redesign doc created today. Adding a separate myth-slug property duplicates psychology that already lives in engine/character_appearance.py PERSONALITY_FIELDS (lines 136-152: traits, fears, traumas), Player.memories, and room witnesses.
sections.how:
1. Remove EMOTION_MYTHS (lines 591-645) and CharacterEmotionState.emotion_myths (line 708) from prototypes/emotions/schema.py and its export from prototypes/emotions/__init__.py (lines 15, 26).
2. Replace the three state.emotion_myths loops in prototypes/emotions/coupling.py (lines 176-182, 237-250, 448-455) with derivation from existing ViWo fields: Player.traits / persona.personality.traits (e.g. stoic, composed, guarded, proud, stubborn, paranoid), recalled memories (e.g. honesty/abandonment/control wounds), and event.witnesses (public exposure driving suppression and secondary shame/anger).
3. Remove emotion_myths references from prototypes/emotions/proto_c_dual_mind.py (line 259), prototypes/emotions/viwo_adapter.py (line 220), prototypes/emotions/scenarios.py, prototypes/emotions/lab_app.py (lines 27, 707), and prototypes/emotions/test_prototypes.py.
4. Update docs/design/emotion-system-redesign.md (lines 168, 300, 393, 485, 554, 591) so no emotion_myths property is proposed for persona.personality.
sections.verify: Run pytest prototypes/emotions/test_prototypes.py -v and verify rg/Select-String finds zero occurrences of emotion_myths or EMOTION_MYTHS across prototypes/emotions/ and docs/design/emotion-system-redesign.md.

acceptance.text: EMOTION_MYTHS and CharacterEmotionState.emotion_myths are removed from prototypes/emotions/schema.py, __init__.py, coupling.py, proto_c_dual_mind.py, viwo_adapter.py, scenarios.py, lab_app.py, and test_prototypes.py.

Expression suppression, secondary emotions (e.g. fear -> shame/anger, lying -> guilt), and calming resistance in prototypes/emotions/coupling.py are derived purely from existing persona traits, recalled memories, and event.witnesses.
docs/design/emotion-system-redesign.md removes all emotion_myths schema proposals and documents trait + memory + audience secondary-emotion dynamics instead.
pytest prototypes/emotions/test_prototypes.py passes with zero references to emotion_myths anywhere in prototypes/emotions/ or docs/design/emotion-system-redesign.md.

custom.browser_ui: In prototypes/emotions/lab_app.py (Emotion Lab UI), remove the Emotion Myths selector/preset control (line 707) and drive the interactive controls from character traits, memories, and witnesses instead. Manual check: open the Emotion Lab UI, verify zero emotion-myth controls remain, and confirm stoic/composed traits + witnesses still trigger expression suppression and masked micro-tells.

evidence: pytest tests/test_speech_tone.py tests/test_sound.py tests/test_spatial_invariants.py prototypes/emotions/test_prototypes.py: 100 passed in 8.93s.
Select-String across prototypes/emotions/*.py and docs/design/emotion-system-redesign.md returned 0 occurrences of emotion_myths or EMOTION_MYTHS.
